Child '''Barlett''' is a scout in the [[Children of the Light]].

== Appearance ==
He is lean with a scar on one cheek.

== Activities ==
He leaves [[Seanchan]] controlled territory with [[Galadedrid Damodred]]. He scouts the path for Galad's army as they make their way through swampland. Barlett and the rest of the scouts are actually loyal to [[Rhadam Asunawa]] and lead Galad's force to a much larger force of Children of the Light under Seanchan control.

==Trivia==
*Barlett is named after Scott Bartlett, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
